PT PLN (Persero) mengerahkan tim untuk memulihkan kelistrikan di Sumatra Utara yang mengalami mati listrik. Pasalnya, wilayah tersebut mengalami pemadaman listrik sejak 18.44 WIB.

"Saat ini tim teknis PLN telah diterjunkan ke lapangan untuk melakukan pengecekan menyeluruh pada sistem dan jaringan kelistrikan, sekaligus menelusuri penyebab gangguan yang terjadi," ujar Darma dalam keterangannya setelah dikonfirmasi Liputan6.com, Jumat (22/5/2026).

Dia mengimbau masyarakat untuk tetap tenang dan tidak panik.

Adapun, informasi perkembangan penanganan gangguan akan disampaikan secara berkala melalui aplikasi PLN Mobile dan layanan Contact Center PLN 123.

🇬🇧 If you live in the UK… this is something you NEED to know!

♻️ New bin rules are coming in England – and yes, they’re stricter now!
You can’t just throw everything in one bin anymore.

🆕 What’s changing?

You now need to separate your waste into:
	•	🗑️ General waste
	•	🍎 Food waste
	•	📄 Paper & cardboard
	•	♻️ Dry recycling (plastic, glass, metal)

❌ Big mistake people make:

Putting the WRONG items in recycling bins.

There’s a list of 30+ items you shouldn’t put in bins, including:
	•	🔹 Non-packaging glass (mirrors, Pyrex)
	•	🍔 Dirty food containers
	•	🥤 Some plastics that aren’t recyclable
	•	🌱 Compostable packaging (yes… confusing!)
	•	❌ Random mixed waste

⚠️ Why this matters:

If you don’t follow the rules, you could face fines up to £400!

🌍 Why the UK is doing this:
	•	✅ Improve recycling
	•	✅ Reduce waste confusion
	•	✅ Make rules the same across the country (no more postcode confusion!)

💡 What you should do:
	•	📌 Check your local council rules
	•	🗑️ Separate waste properly
	•	❌ Don’t assume everything is recyclable

😬 Reality:

Most people are already doing this WRONG – so make sure you get it right!

Lebih RM4 juta kenaikan kos diesel terpaksa ditanggung KDEB Waste Management (KDEBWM) setiap bulan, bagi operasi kutipan sisa susulan ketegangan global semasa.

Pengarah Urusannya Dato’ Ramli Mohd Tahir berkata lonjakan lebih 60 peratus itu menyebabkan kos operasi bulanan meningkat hampir RM10 juta, berbanding sekitar RM6 juta sebelum ini.

Menurutnya, kenaikan mendadak itu memberi tekanan besar kepada operasi kira-kira 1,300 lori KDEBWM setiap hari, satu cabaran kepada kecekapan sistem pengurusan sisa dan kelangsungan perkhidmatan.

“Setiap lori perlu membuat beberapa perjalanan sehari. Jika kos diesel meningkat 30 hingga 40 peratus setiap perjalanan, jumlah keseluruhan boleh mencecah hampir dua kali ganda.

“Namun, kami akan cuba mengekalkan jadual kutipan supaya tidak berlaku lambakan sampah, seterusnya beri kesan kepada krisis kesihatan awam,” katanya dalam program Bicara Semasa terbitan Media Selangor.

Harga runcit bagi diesel di Semenanjung terus meningkat pada RM6.02 seliter bagi tempoh 2 hingga 8 April susulan krisis tenaga dunia yang berlanjutan.

The trash industry, also known as waste management, involves the collection, transportation, processing, recycling, and disposal of waste materials. It's a crucial sector for maintaining public health and environmental sustainability. Here are some key aspects:

1. **Types of Waste**: Waste can be categorized into several types, including municipal solid waste (household trash), hazardous waste (toxic materials), industrial waste (byproducts from manufacturing), and electronic waste (discarded electronics).

2. **Collection and Transportation**: Waste is typically collected by municipal services or private companies. Collection methods can vary, with curbside pickup being common for residential areas. After collection, waste is transported to processing facilities.

3. **Recycling**: A significant focus of the trash industry is recycling, which involves converting waste materials into new products. This helps reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills and conserves natural resources.

4. **Landfills**: Landfills are designated areas where waste is disposed of. Modern landfills are designed to minimize environmental impact, with systems in place to manage leachate (liquid that drains from waste) and capture methane gas produced by decomposing waste.

5. **Waste-to-Energy**: Some facilities convert waste into energy through incineration or anaerobic digestion. This process can generate electricity and reduce the volume of waste.

6. **Regulations**: The trash industry is heavily regulated to ensure safe and environmentally responsible waste management practices. Regulations vary by country and region.

7. **Challenges**: The industry faces challenges such as increasing waste generation, contamination of recyclable materials, and the need for more sustainable practices.

Overall, the trash industry plays a vital role in managing waste and promoting environmental health. If you have specific questions or a particular aspect you're interested in, feel free to ask!

KDEB Waste Management (KDEBWM) menjangka peningkatan sisa bazar Ramadan tahun ini berbanding 73.67 tan metrik sampah yang dikutip setiap hari pada 2023.

Pengarah Urusan KDEBWM, Dato’ Ramli Mohd Tahir menasihati orang ramai supaya berdisiplin membuang sisa makanan dan mengurus sampah tersebut dengan sistematik, lapor Sinar Harian.

“Sekiranya ini dapat kita lakukan dengan disiplin yang tinggi, insya-Allah akan dapat mengurangkan lambakan sampah domestik,” kata beliau semasa ditemui di program pakej makanan kepada 1,500 orang yang berbuka puasa semasa program Iftar Ala Madinah@Karangkraf semalam.

Program kebajikan itu termasuk serahan duit raya kepada 100 orang anak yatim dan asnaf daripada Pertubuhan Rahoma Darul Fakir dan Yayasan Islam Darul Ehsan.
